description: Verify, review, and freeze the Cambridge YLE 2025 baseline of the existing English lexical graph; define static-graph + learner-state next-step consumption; validate reading-program fixtures; human go/no-go. Not a standing regeneration pipeline. A2 Key/B1 method-later only.
deviation_notes: 2026-08-10 strategy revision: retargeted from full multi-exam regeneration/release ceremony to one-time YLE 2025 baseline freeze, relationship fact-vs-signal review, consumption/next-step contract, reading-program validation, dual human freeze decision, and bounded sanity only. Plan markers normalized to [x]/[~]/[b] (human-gate owners). First executable work is Phase 1 scope lock. Substantive audit work is not marked complete. estimated_tasks = 25 top-level Task lines. Framework note: measure_interphase_checks.py task regex still matches [ ~x] only, so [b] human gates are invisible to its incomplete counts until the checker is aligned. 2026-08-11 Phase 2: the first Phase 2 Green (26e6d10) was refuted by an independent source oracle and reworked. The committed audit had validated its parser against a hardcoded {starters:491, movers:392, flyers:507} draft dictionary; the official list holds 1,407 direct rows (495/399/513). All 17 dropped rows were ingested (2daf568), so the tracked YLE baseline moved from 1,388 to 1,405 skills and Phase 1's snapshot was restated. Task count grew by one top-level Phase 2 remediation task (26 total).
